title: NBI: P7-B Davao City flood control projects awarded to single contractor

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has discovered that flood control projects amounting to around P7 billion in the first district of Davao City were awarded to a single contractor from 2018 to 2024, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said Thursday.
